name: zebepay
description: Nigerian banking and wallet infrastructure foundation.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @zebepay/shared && npm run build -w @zebepay/api && npm run build -w @zebepay/customer-web && npm run build -w @zebepay/admin-web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @zebepay/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @zebepay/shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
